_what: How a plan of dated stages moves when its start or end moves (src/date-shift.mjs). A stage is { id, start, end } in whole days (start and end both count). `strategies` are the named ways the unlocked stages fill the new window: each row's id is a function in date-shift.mjs's STRATEGIES, its `says` is what the person is told it does. `locks` are the named lock modes: a stage is locked (never moves) when it holds any flag the mode lists; `done` is finished work and `started` is a stage whose start is today or earlier. Locked stages must come before every unlocked stage. `words` are every refusal, in plain words with {braces} filled in. A new strategy is a row here plus its function; a new lock mode is only a row.

strategies.label: Shift
strategies.says: Every stage moves by the same number of days and keeps its length.

strategies.label: Absorb
strategies.says: Only the stage at the moved end changes; it grows or shrinks and every other stage stays put.

strategies.label: Distribute
strategies.says: The stages fill the whole new window one after another, each keeping its share of the days.

strategies.label: Accordion
strategies.says: Every stage keeps its length; the gaps between stages stretch or tighten evenly.

strategies.label: Shrink
strategies.says: The end comes in: the last stages are cut back first, none below one day, and none starts later than it did.

words.no_stages: There are no dated stages to move.
words.bad_stage: Stage {id} must start on or before it ends, with both as dates.
words.no_change: Give the new start, the new end, or both.
words.unknown_strategy: {id} is not a way to move a plan. The ways are: {ids}.
words.unknown_lock: {id} is not a lock mode. The modes are: {ids}.
words.locked_gap: Stage {id} is not locked but comes before locked work. Locked stages must come first.
words.start_locked: The plan's start cannot move while its first stage is locked.
words.nothing_to_move: Every stage is locked, so nothing can move.
words.shift_differs: Shift keeps every length, so the start and the end must move by the same number of days.
words.hits_locked: The stages would run into locked work that ends on {date}.
words.collapses: Stage {id} would end before it starts. Choose a later end or another way.
words.too_few_days: {days} days cannot hold {count} stages of at least one day each.
words.too_long: The stages need {needed} days and the window has {days}.
words.shrink_only_shortens: Shrink only brings the end in. Use another way to move it later.
words.not_a_plan: Choose a task list or name the tasks to move.
words.none_dated: None of those tasks has a due date, so there is nothing to move.
